bundle.shortDescription: Local-first credential, document and task manager
bundle.longDescription: Zynky keeps your passwords, notes and tasks as plain Markdown files in a folder you own. Secrets are encrypted with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM and synced peer-to-peer with Syncthing.
